Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement (SAMPLE TEXT FOR TESTING)

Recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace. Job gains have slowed, and the unemployment rate has edged up but remains low.

Inflation has moved up further and remains elevated, reflecting in part higher energy prices.

In support of its goals, the Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 4-3/4 to 5 percent. In considering the extent of additional adjustments to the target range, the Committee will carefully assess incoming data.

Voting for the monetary policy action were Chair A, Vice Chair B, and Governor C. Voting against the action were Governor D and Governor E, who preferred to maintain the target range.
